items.title: Roger Mitchell Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: Father John A. Darcy, Council No. 50 of New Orleans, Louisiana.

ctx.x: Well, I always lived, tried to live right, you know what I mean? Still in my church and all.

Father John A. Darcy, Council No. 50 of New Orleans, Louisiana. It's nice. That's what I say. And he also had, he said, his other certificate of the Knights of Peter Cleves. But still Father John A. Darcy, Council No. 50, it's nice. I lost, I lost my... I'm sure you did something good with your life.

I lost, I lost my penny the other day when I was going around by the market there. Before you had your penny. I never heard nobody before. I got a, that was merits of being in the organization so long.
